releaseNotes:
Official Release v1.3.35:
- Ultra-Fast Native Printing Engine: Native rawprint.exe Windows driver cuts receipt print delay from 5.5s down to 0.2s without PowerShell process startup overhead.
- High-Density Logo Calibration: Re-calibrated inverted ESC/POS receipt logo to 33.14% black dot density. Palm trees and LA MICHOACANA text print rich, solid black on pure white paper with zero washed-out white text and zero black blocks.
- Smart Station Pairing & Discovery: Hardware stations setup wizard automatically discovers Central Server IP and prompts for Central Register IP on secondary screens, eliminating 127.0.0.1 connection refused errors.
- Quick IP Switcher [C]: Added option [C] in station hardware installer to view and change Central Server IP at any time.
- 100% Quality Standard: Passed all pre-flight simulator checks and integrity audits with 0 errors and 0 warnings.
